name: Run Starlark Script (branches)
description: Execute a Starlark (Python-like) script that transforms data and routes the flow to one of three branches. `return <data>` fires the centered branch; `return output("left"|"right", <data>)` fires a side; `return stop()` halts.

script.title: Script
script.description: Starlark script defining `def main(arguments): ...`. Return data (centered branch), output(name, data) for a side/custom branch, or stop() to halt.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Input object passed to the script as `arguments` (typically wired from previous playbook nodes).

outputs.left: Fires when the script returns left(<data>).
outputs.main: Fires when the script returns data directly (the centered, primary branch).
outputs.right: Fires when the script returns right(<data>).
